Usage:
<pre><nowiki>
{{Tileset|
|filename=Herrbdog_16x16_tileset.gif
|title=herrbdog_16x16
|image=[[File:Herrbdog_16x16_tileset.gif]]
|author=[[User:Herrbdog|Herrbdog]]
|dated=2007-11-15
|size=16&amp;times;16
|resolution=1280&amp;times;400
|versions=14&times;14, 16&times;16
|comments=This is Herrbdog's well-known tileset.
|demo=
|demo2=
|demo3=
|demo4=
}}
</nowiki></pre>

It is best to specify <code>filename=tileset.png</code>, and leave <code>title</code> and <code>image</code> unspecified, in most cases.

Output:

{{Tileset|
|filename=Herrbdog_16x16_tileset.gif
|title=herrbdog_16x16
|image=[[File:Herrbdog_16x16_tileset.gif]]
|author=[[User:Herrbdog|Herrbdog]]
|dated=2007-11-15
|size=16&times;16
|resolution=1280&times;400
|versions=14&times;14, 16&times;16
|comments=This is Herrbdog's well-known tileset.
|demo=
|demo2=
|demo3=
|demo4=
}}
